short_description: Provision Azure postgres + storage for cortex-dev
description:
We need a new postgres flexible server and storage account for the cortex application in the dev environment.

Cost center: CC-4421

Requirements:
- Postgres Flexible Server, Standard_D2s_v3, eastus2
- Storage account for blobs, LRS, eastus2
- Must use existing rg-cortex-dev if it exists
- Postgres must NOT go in the app resource group
